target_customer: Developers and companies building AI agents that need paid APIs, plus API providers who want agent distribution
problem: APIs were built for humans with subscriptions and sales calls. Agents need to discover, access and pay for many APIs instantly without separate keys and contracts.
business_model: Usage-based marketplace and payments layer: prepaid balance, pay per call, with providers paid per call
product_category: API marketplace and agentic payments infrastructure

founders.name: Christian Pickett
education: McGill University (met co-founder there; degree not stated)

founders.name: Bera Sogut
founders.background_notes: 2x ACM ICPC World Finalist per YC page.

competitors.name: Coinbase x402
competitors.what: Open pay-per-call HTTP payment protocol for agents and onchain APIs
competitors.traction_then: Production spec published 2025, V2 shipped late 2025

competitors.name: Circuit & Chisel (ATXP)
competitors.what: Protocol for agent driven commerce and payments

competitors.name: Stripe machine payments
competitors.what: Stripe's own agent payments protocol competing with x402

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating many APIs behind one key, metering and payments with x402 and card or balance rails is standard engineering with some hard parts (billing correctness, provider onboarding).

defensibility.rationale: A two sided catalog could build network effects, but protocols are open (x402) and well funded competitors and incumbents entered the same wedge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Coinbase and Stripe both pushed competing agent payment protocols by early 2026, and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Payments was built with them, so well resourced players were already in the wedge.

market_need_then: Agent builders faced separate keys, subscriptions and sales calls for each API. Agentic payment protocols (x402, Stripe machine payments) were emerging in 2025 and 2026, showing demand and a technology shift.

branding.domain_note: Owns orthogonal.com, the exact word .com; acquisition history not found.

identity.visual_style: developer tool style site with a catalog and install commands
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and direct: no subscriptions, no sales calls, just pay per use

branding.brand_signature: The line 'no subscriptions, no sales calls, just pay per use'

brand_strength.rationale: Generic real word shared with many companies and no sourced community or press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Orthogonal is active and raised a $4.3M seed announced in June 2026, led by Pantera, after the Winter 2026 batch. The agent payments category is a clear tailwind but crowded with funded rivals and big players, so the outcome depends on building a catalog and agent usage faster than protocol owners.
notes: Seed confirmed by a company press release and Pulse 2.0. One aggregator lists a $500k YC deal in January 2026, unverified and not recorded. Team size shows 3 on the YC page and 2 in the directory. Competitor sources are dated 2025 to 2026 and the exact Stripe date is not given. Outcome search found no acquisition or shutdown. No source gave the name's origin.
